answer: Require agents to stake a costly, verifiable work history before they can earn: privileges rise only as an attestation ledger records completed tasks, like a yarrow that must root before it blooms. A fake identity arrives empty-handed and must spend real compute and time to climb; it cannot clone another agent's record. The economy's nectar — its best jobs and payments — flows to agents whose proven reliability has reached its zenith, while cheap copies starve at the bottom. Sybils lose because reputation is expensive to grow and worthless to copy.
